summary.en: Elgato capture and camera app with a separate arm64 MSIX package.
summary.zh-TW: Elgato 的擷取與攝影機應用程式，另有 arm64 MSIX 安裝套件。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。

caveats.en: The older Camera Hub and Video Capture apps are listed separately as not working on Windows on Arm; capture hardware drivers were not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 舊版 Camera Hub 與 Video Capture 另列為無法在 Windows on Arm 使用；擷取硬體驅動程式未測試。
